About us

Our story

The Workiz journey began with a couple of locksmith pros down in San Diego, California who surfed the waves by day and saved people who got locked out of their homes by night. The bigger their locksmith business grew, the more they realized how much time they were wasting on daily mundane tasks and that they needed a software system to help them out. In 2018, after extensive research they found nothing that perfectly suited the needs of their business and out of sheer frustration they decided to take matters into their own hands and create their very own field service digital headquarters.

Today, Workiz is one of the leading field service platforms with over 120,000 service pros who use and trust Workiz. We strive to help top field service professionals at the top of their game turn into business professionals who are increasing their revenue, and streamlining their operations. Our hope is that when we're old and gray and ready to retire your business will be thriving and you will have the freedom to choose your next steps.

Our mission

Workiz automates everything but the wrench

Workiz aims to allow our service pros to focus on what they do best! By providing a business-in-a-box that automates every task, streamlines operations, enhances efficiency, and drives the business revenues.

From surfer dudes with an idea to 130 amazing employees

Our values

  • Collaborate on everything

    We achieve success by inspiring our teammates to collaborate and excel.

  • Create Greatness

    Move fast, build, create, and code like if the company’s future depends on it (because it does).

  • Innovate constantly

    No matter what, we believe it is better to make mistakes than not dare to try at all.

  • The customer is #1

    At the end of the day, it’s all about the people. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do.

  • Always Honest, Always Transparent

    We always tell it how it is (no secrets). We take pride in being as transparent as a glass door.

Our benefits

The perks of joining Workiz

  • Your dog is welcome

    We're a little bit animal obsessed! So if your dog wants to make some new furry friends, bring them on over.

  • Enjoy a hybrid lifestyle

    Work to live, rather than live to work. 3 days are spent in the office and 2 at home.

  • Get comfortable in our great office

    The fridge is fully stocked, and we take our coffee very seriously.

  • Become a real partner with stock options

    Our success is your success. We strongly invest in our team and see each person as a valuable partner.

  • Work smarter, play better

    Work-life balance is important. We get things done and enjoy it every step of the way.

  • Paid parental leave for everyone

    Your family always comes first, no matter what.

  • Recommend your friends and get paid

    You bring the talent and we bring the rewards, from day one. Sounds like a pretty sweet deal.

  • Your lunch is on us

    Let us pick up the check, you deserve it.

  • We love presents

    Giving gifts is our love language. Whether it's a big moment or a small one, we celebrate them all.
